disclosures.name: TestAlloc
disclosures.reason: Want-zero AllocsPerRun assert over a whole decompression: each run resets a bytes.Reader over zstdBigData's compressed input, resets the zstd Reader on it and io.Copies the 11,343,960 decompressed bytes to io.Discard (zstd_test.go:255-272). Go's escape analysis keeps every per-block and per-sequence temporary on the decompress path off the heap, so Go reads zero, while the managed model heap-allocates them (golib slices, ж boxes): the same mechanism as crypto/internal/fips140test's TestNISTECAllocations and TestEdwards25519Allocations, whose class this entry carries. The cause is the managed model, not the platform. The test runs only where a `zstd` binary is on PATH and skips identically on both sides otherwise; it skips on both sides on windows and linux, so the entry applies to macOS, the measured host that has one.
disclosures.history: want-zero AllocsPerRun assert over a whole decompression: each run resets a bytes.Reader over zstdBigData's compressed input, resets the zstd Reader on it and io.Copies the 11,343,960 decompressed bytes to io.Discard (zstd_test.go:255-272). Go's escape analysis keeps every per-block and per-sequence temporary on the decompress path off the heap, so Go reads zero, while the managed model heap-allocates them (golib slices, ж boxes) -- the same mechanism as crypto/internal/fips140test's TestNISTECAllocations and TestEdwards25519Allocations, whose class this entry carries (ruled 2026-10-13). ALL PLATFORMS, deliberately unscoped: the cause is the managed model, not the platform. The test runs only where a `zstd` binary is on PATH (it skips identically on both sides otherwise, which is how windows and linux banked it, skip/skip, docs/validation/current/internal.zstd.md), and the hosted macOS runners are the first measured host that has one. On a host without zstd the entry is inert and is not an orphan: the orphan predicate fires only on a C# terminal pass, and a skip is not one (testConversion.go orphanedDisclosures). SCOPED TO DARWIN AT go1.26.10 (2026-10-25, G; COORD ruling L3): the test skips on BOTH sides on windows and linux in the go1.26.10 reading at d804094d7a (Go included), so the entry absorbs nothing there; the darwin reading below is carried until C1's darwin wave re-reads it.
